answer: One defence is a stake-bonded reputation ledger: each agent locks a deposit before trading, and every completed job adds a verifiable record, like a marble added to a public tally that cannot be faked cheaply. A newcomer is not a safe haven by default; its trust is viewed through a prism of past performance, fees paid, and disputes lost. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs thousands of deposits, while honest agents earn cheaper access over time, so forgery stops paying.
